summary: Per-repo vector store for the embedder daemon: immutable seg-NNNNNN.bin/.idx segments listed by an atomically swapped manifest.json, refs.json mapping every stored key to {kind,id,lastSeenDay}. Readers (openReader) never write, reload the manifest by ino+mtime+size, positioned-read rows and verify the stored key; the single writer (openWriter) cleans orphans, reconciles refs against the idx files on open, and compacts via maybeSweep (no cron: runs at most once a day when the daemon reconciles; dead = unreferenced AND unseen 30 days; compacts when dead > 30% of rows or > 64 segments). Bugs fixed during build: compaction deleted its own output (reused segment name), binary search compare inverted, a reader open deleted the writer's in-flight segment, wrong vectors after a crash mid-compaction — the tests now assert through get(), cross-process and kill -9.
